# Clear View Home Inspections, LLC

> Licensed home inspection company in Fishers, Indiana, serving Indianapolis and Central Indiana since 1999. Full home inspections, radon testing, mold testing, termite certification, new construction and pre-drywall, well & septic, and commercial inspections. Phone (317) 578-0890, info@cvhi.us.

## Services
- [Full home inspections](https://www.cvhi.us/home-inspections/): What's covered under Indiana's standards of practice (878 IAC 1-2-1), 2-3 hours, report within 24 hours
- [All services](https://www.cvhi.us/services/)
- [Radon testing](https://www.cvhi.us/services/radon-testing/)
- [Contact & scheduling](https://www.cvhi.us/contact-us/)

## Guides (sourced)
- [How much does a home inspection cost in Indiana?](https://www.cvhi.us/blog/home-inspection-cost-indiana/): Indiana home inspection costs in 2026: typical ranges by square footage, add-on prices for radon, termite, mold and sewer scope, and what the fee covers.
- [Should I get a radon test during my home inspection in Indiana?](https://www.cvhi.us/blog/radon-testing-central-indiana/): Nearly 1 in 3 Indiana homes is estimated to be above EPA's 4.0 pCi/L radon action level. What Central Indiana buyers should know about testing.
- [How are home inspectors licensed in Indiana?](https://www.cvhi.us/blog/indiana-home-inspector-licensing/): Indiana home inspector licensing: training, national exam, $100,000 insurance, 32 CE hours per renewal, and how to verify a license online.
